jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about shaping the future of capital markets through Digital Assets and Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT)? Do you want to help define and scale regulated, institutional digital asset products and services across a global Investment Bank? We’re looking for a Director level Product Manager to join the IB Digital Assets (Products & Services) team. In this role, you will shape and deliver the Investment Bank’s digital assets agenda, translating the potential of digital assets and DLT-based business models into scalable products, services, and business models embedded within and alongside core IB businesses.

We’re looking for a Digital Assets-focused Product Manager to:

• act as end to end Product Manager for defined Digital Assets products, services, and DLT based business models across the Investment Bank
• own the pipeline and roadmap for assigned Digital Assets products, services, and business models, from ideation and prioritisation through to pilot/MVP execution and handover to Change SMEs for scaling and BAU adoption
• originate, structure, and progress business cases for IB Digital Assets pilots and MVPs, including value proposition, economics, risks, dependencies, and success metrics
• partner closely with Front Office, Financing, Risk, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and Technology to enable IB Digital Assets pilots/MVPs in existing IB workflows and operating models
• evaluate internal and external digital/DLT capabilities to determine optimal build, buy, partner, or reuse strategies based on feasibility, maturity, cost, and time to market
• appraise future state IB business and operating models required to scale Digital Assets products and services within IB and Group control frameworks
• act as a senior point of contact and thought partner, engaging internal stakeholders and selected external participants to shape IB positioning, partnerships, and market developments

jobs.title: Cross Border Business Risk Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you curious how a client advisor can service clients from different countries? Are you able to distil complex information to make it simple and relevant?

Effective cross-border risk management is important to our continued success as a global wealth manager. We're looking for a Subject-Matter-Expert for APAC Business Risk Organisation (APAC BRO) to:

• be part of the GWM APAC Cross-border Competency Centre, covering Cross-border Framework and Cross-border Product Alignment Rules (PAR).
• provide 1st line advice and training to Markets relating to policy/framework matters, travel processes, and country-specific restrictions
• manage the various APAC Lead Market Head (LMH) report reviews by collaborating with stakeholders for submission to senior committees (e.g. Global Cross-border Operating Committee)
• be the GWM APAC voice in global forums by representing APAC regional interests, taking decisions, escalating issues and cascading information
• implement small changes to the framework, processes or related IT capabilities for GWM APAC
• provide subject-matter-expertise to innovation and digital projects.

jobs.title: Fund Accountant
jobs.description:
Do you have a strong attention to detail that enables robust accounting oversight and sound risk governance? Do you thrive in cross‑functional and multi‑regional environments? Are you a diligent, process‑driven professional with deep fund accounting expertise?
We are looking for a Fund Accountant who will play a key role in overseeing Taiwan fund accounting activities and contributing to regional initiatives.
The successful candidate will:
• Represent Taiwan Fund Accounting at both local and regional levels, and contribute to cross functional and cross regional projects
• Support and oversee fund accounting–related regulatory reporting
• Apply strong technical expertise in NAV calculation and valuation
• Demonstrate a strong risk and control mindset in overseeing fund administration vendors
• Coordinate fund financial statement audits with external auditors
• Manage trade processing, settlement, and related controls, working closely with front and middle offices to resolve trade discrepancies and mitigate operational risks
• Act as a key point of contact for external clients and internal stakeholders, responding to fund accounting–related inquiries in a timely and professional manner
• Ensure all control processes and procedures (e.g., reconciliations, payments) comply with UBS standards, internal policies, and regulatory requirements
• Support and manage fund life‑cycle events, including (but not limited to) fund launches, mergers, liquidations, and fund maturities
• Design and deliver customized reports to meet client and business requirements
• Provide support for APAC cross‑regional initiatives and tasks as required

• take ownership of end-to-end delivery within a collaborative and agile environment.
• embrace complex business requirements and enjoy the challenge of translating them into intelligent solutions.
• work as part of an agile development team within a global technology team.

jobs.title: Counterparty Credit Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
Are you naturally curious and ambitious? Do you have sharp analytic skills? We’re looking for someone like that who can:
• Cover Financial Institutions, including global Banks, Insurance companies, Broker Dealers, Sovereign and similar entities.
• Evaluate counterparty credit risk based on analysis of both quantitative and qualitative factors, including fundamental credit analysis, to recommend internal ratings, LGD and credit limits.
• Prepare written counterparty annual reviews/transactional credit proposals drawing conclusions relating to credit assessment, risk appetite, exposure drivers and business prospects
• Understand counterparty credit exposure associated with OTC derivatives (FX, Fixed Income, Equities), securities financing, exchange traded derivatives, banking products and structured transactions.
• Perform ad hoc credit risk analysis and participate in portfolio reviews to identify risk developments or concentrations

jobs.title: New Zealand Securities Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you ready to be at the center of equity trading operations in Australia & New Zealand?

Do you thrive working closely with the trading desk, taking ownership of risk outcomes, and improving how things are done?

We’re looking for a proactive Middle Office professional seeking genuine front office exposure, ownership of key controls, and the opportunity to drive meaningful process improvement and automation—primarily for New Zealand, with additional responsibility supporting Australia.

In this role, you’ll sit at the heart of the Australia & New Zealand Equities business, partnering closely with Trading, Business Management, clients, and global support teams. You’ll own critical front to back controls, ensure trade integrity, and play a key role in managing operational and risk outcomes on T0 and beyond.
You’ll be trusted to act decisively, think critically, and continuously improve how we support the business.

• Own and operate a suite of front to back controls, identifying and capturing risk events as part of the first line of defense
• Ensure T0 trade data integrity, with a strong focus on completeness, accuracy, and timeliness
• Produce and facilitate sign off for T0 risk reporting and T+1 reconciliations
• Act as a key point of contact for Australia & New Zealand Equities Trading desks and Business Managers, providing time critical support
• Liaise with clients and external brokers to resolve trade booking and economic discrepancies
• Partner with the business and local support functions on new initiatives, change, and process improvement to enhance efficiency and control
• Drive automation and continuous improvement, leveraging data and tooling to reduce risk and manual effort

jobs.title: US Tax Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Tax Specialist to join our UBS Asset Management Tax Team as an Associate Director.
Specifically, the job holder is expected to:
• Collaborate with all business areas of AM across the US region to manage and resolve tax issues related to AM products, including the development of new products and providing specialized asset management tax advice on structuring and efficiency at the fund, investor, and portfolio levels
• Oversee annual tax compliance processes for various fund types (trading funds, private credit funds, fund of funds, mutual funds), ensuring adherence to all relevant regulations
• Manage and monitor FATCA/CRS, FBAR, 1099, and shareholder reporting for UBS AM Funds
• Serve as the primary contact for investor inquiries regarding tax reporting deliverables, ensuring timely and accurate responses and thorough reviews of investor deliverables (e.g., K-1 forms, estimated tax letters)
• Ensure timely filing of all tax returns and compliance with Group Tax policies and supplements
• Manage tax risk (financial and reputational) across the region, including, but not limited to:
o Regular reviews and reporting of tax risk issues to the US Head of AM Tax
o Implementing procedures and controls to mitigate tax risk
o Monitoring tax and operational risk related to third-party service providers (fund administrators, advisors)
• Provide prompt and comprehensive responses to investor inquiries
• Support portfolio managers by addressing fund-related questions concerning jurisdictional requirements, diversification tests, and withholding tax matters
• Support business initiatives through the TRPA process, including pre- and post-launch conditions and coordination with Group Tax specialists for country-specific and indirect/specialist tax sign-off
• Manage the appointment and oversight of external advisors on tax matters, ensuring compliance with UBS internal contract management requirements
• Review of tax wording in fund documentation and other AM relevant legal agreements
• Build and maintain relationships with senior management and UBS Group stakeholders to establish and communicate tax priorities based on changing regulatory environments

jobs.title: Quantitative Analyst – Client Analytics & TCA
jobs.description:
We are seeking a quantitative analyst to provide and support execution consulting, client analytics and transaction cost analysis (TCA) for the APAC Agency Algorithmic Trading platform. The role is analytics led and client facing, with responsibility for explaining execution outcomes and algorithm performance to internal stakeholders and clients.
You will:
• Produce client facing execution analysis and TCA across APAC equity markets.
• Analyse algorithmic execution performance across benchmarks, market conditions, and execution styles.
• Translate quantitative results into clear, actionable insights for client reviews and discussions including practical recommendations on algo usage, parameter choices, and execution trade offs.
• Support analytics methodology, benchmarks, and follow up analysis in response to client and stakeholder questions.
• Work with Trading, Product, Technology, and Control teams to ensure analytics accurately reflect platform behaviour and client flow.
• Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of production analytics used in client reporting, including the scaling and automation of the analytics - helping standardise recurring analyses, improve repeatability, and reduce manual effort.

jobs.description:
As part of our strategic vision to expand our well-established Custody offering, UBS Europe SE is preparing to launch execution-to-custody services for Banks and Regulated Brokers within European markets through our Frankfurt legal entity by mid-2026. We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Sales professional to join our team.

This role offers a unique opportunity to not only drive sales for our custody services but also to play a pivotal role in shaping and establishing our custody offering in Germany for long-term success. The successful candidate will lead sales initiatives, provide advisory support to clients post-mandate, and collaborate with local and Zurich-based management to build a robust local presence.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead sales efforts to introduce and grow custody solutions for Banks and Regulated Brokers in Europe.
• Develop and execute effective sales strategies to promote custody services either stand-alone or in combination with trade execution.
• Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the custody market, building strong client relationships and representing UBS ESE as a trusted partner.
• Ensure flawless product implementation and provide ongoing advisory support to clients post-mandate, ensuring long-term satisfaction and retention.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless delivery of custody services and contribute to the strategic growth of the custody business in Germany.
• Prepare and deliver compelling proposals, presentations, and contracts to clients.
• Monitor and report on sales performance metrics, adjusting strategies as needed to achieve targets.

jobs.title: Spécialiste Crédits 80-100%
jobs.description:
Êtes-vous passionné par les prêts bancaires ? Vous êtes autonome, fiable et possédez une grande conscience professionnelle ? Vous appréciez travailler dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant où les objectifs vous motivent ? Si vous avez répondu oui à ces questions, alors rejoignez notre équipe Credit Services et faites partie d'une entreprise où votre talent sera reconnu et valorisé.

En tant que spécialiste crédits, vous serez chargé de :

• traiter les demandes de prêt approuvées à l'échelle nationale, en jouant un rôle clé dans la réalisation des projets de nos clients
• préparer les contrats de crédit avec les documents de sûreté appropriés, assurant ainsi la documentation nécessaire à nos prêts
• saisir et gérer les crédits et garanties (p.ex. les cédules hypothécaires, polices et cautions)
• emettre les promesses de paiement et leur exécution
• assurer la correspondance et le dialogue avec les registres fonciers, notaires, banques et compagnies d’assurance, établissant des relations de confiance avec nos partenaires
• maintenir des contacts professionnels avec les conseillers à la clientèle, les Credit Officers et les services juridiques
